payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL generation, detailing their methodologies and performance comparisons.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include models like Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which utilize advanced techniques such as bi-LSTMs and attention mechanisms for SQL generation.

Recent approaches achieving state-of-the-art performance involve recursive decoding and graph neural networks for encoding schemas, as well as intermediate representations to connect natural language and SQL.
The editing mechanism proposed in the study improves upon state-of-the-art baselines by reusing previous SQL query results, demonstrating significant accuracy improvements.
